items.headline: $ACE Bridge Exploit Sparks $3.7M Free-For-All
items.summary: A $2M exploit on Fusionist's $ACE bridge turned into a $3.7M scramble as traders drained the pool — one flipped $50 into nearly $17,700.

items.headline: $CYBER Hack: 5.2M Unbacked Tokens Minted
items.summary: AstraSec says 5.213M unbacked $CYBER were minted after LayerZero exited support, with its CEO suspecting Cyber's replacement infrastructure was compromised.

items.headline: $SKY Cofounder May Sell Stake to Repay $77M
items.summary: Rune Christensen is weighing direct $SKY sales — with Du Jun eyeing the entire holding — to repay ~77M USDS as the stUSDS pool shows zero withdrawal liquidity.

items.headline: $ZEC Goes Leveraged: Grayscale's 2x ETF Debuts
items.summary: Grayscale launched ZECX, a 2x leveraged Zcash ETF targeting twice ZCSH's daily return — though it slid 13% on day one.

items.headline: $XLM Bell Upgrade Live With Smart Accounts
items.summary: Stellar's Bell upgrade is live, adding customer-tagged contract addresses and optional post-quantum signature verification to the $XLM network.
